name: C4-4 LLM inference: one layer of the stack
description: Five tokens, each an 8-dim hidden; needs a download

params.label: Hidden-state per token — a real LLM projects this to vocab logits

data.noteContent:
What happens between typing a prompt and reading an answer, with the stack cut to one layer. The prompt tokenises to five pieces - I, ' learned', ' that', ' the', ' cat' - each becomes an 8-number vector from a seeded table, positions are added, and one LayerNorm, attention and feed-forward pass runs.

The result is (5, 8): a hidden state per token, not logits. A real model ends with a Linear projecting the last hidden state onto the whole vocabulary, then samples. That projection is all that is missing here.

Open the attention weights. Where C4-2's byte fragments give a nearly flat matrix, these five clean tokens produce one with real structure, 0.007 to 0.954. The first run downloads the cl100k_base table, later runs are offline.

從打進提示詞到讀出答案之間發生的事，只是把整疊層縮成一層。提示詞切成五塊 - I、' learned'、' that'、' the'、' cat' - 每一塊從一張有種子的表裡取出 8 個數字的向量，加上位置，再跑一次 LayerNorm、注意力和前饋網路。

結果是 (5, 8)：每個 token 一個 hidden state，不是 logits。真正的模型最後會接一顆 Linear，把最後一個 token 的 hidden state 投影到整個詞彙表再抽樣。這裡缺的就只有那一步投影。

注意力權重值得打開來看。C4-2 的位元組碎片給出幾乎平坦的矩陣，而這裡五個乾淨的 token 給出真的有結構的矩陣，從 0.007 到 0.954。第一次執行會下載 cl100k_base 表，之後就不需要網路。

A stand-in for the real thing. The table is 32 rows of 8 numbers filled from a seed, and mode ordinal gives each distinct token the next free row. A production table has fifty thousand rows or more and its numbers are learned - most of what a model knows about a word lives there.

這是真實嵌入表的替身。這張表是 32 列、每列 8 個數字，用種子填出來，mode 設成 ordinal 表示每個不同的 token 依序拿下一個空位。實際模型的嵌入表有五萬列以上，而且數值是學出來的 — 模型對一個詞的理解，大半就在那裡面。

One layer, one head, and causal left off: every token here can look at every other one, including the tokens to its right. A decoder LLM turns causal on so a position can only read what came before it, which is what keeps next-token training honest.

一層、一個 head，而且 causal 沒有打開：這裡每個 token 都看得到其他所有 token，包括右邊的。真正的 decoder LLM 會把 causal 打開，讓每個位置只能讀到它前面的東西，預測下一個 token 的訓練才不會作弊。
